headline: Executive order creates a presidential commission to address drug addiction and the opioid crisis.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new commission focused on drug addiction and the opioid crisis. Based on the title, the commission's job is to work on ways to combat these problems, likely by studying them and advising the President. The title does not say what specific actions, funding, or rule changes, if any, the commission will lead to.

who_it_affects.group: People struggling with drug addiction, including opioid addiction, and their families
who_it_affects.how: The commission's work is aimed at the issues they face, though the order itself does not appear to directly change their services or benefits.

when_it_takes_effect: March 29, 2017, the date it was signed (executive orders usually take effect when signed)
